calibration_rulings.title: Farms one visits: «کھیت», «فارم» or «باغات»?
calibration_rulings.binds: nav.leisure; the category label of the farm group and the souqs-parks-farms page when their rounds come.
calibration_rulings.ruling: B, with the press's qualifier where the word stands alone in a label: the category of farms that receive visitors is «فارم» (masculine; plural «فارم», never «فارمز»), and in the label of the menu and the footer (nav.leisure) it is written «زرعی فارم» — «بازار، تفریح گاہیں اور زرعی فارم» — because two readers in a row read the bare word there as the form one fills in. «باغات» is refused for the group: it is the 'gardens' of the parks label, the label's three groups would read as two, and a rice or strawberry farm is not a «باغ». «کھیت» remains the word for a cultivated field in running text; an orchard or a palm grove is «باغ / باغات». The lime farm keeps «باغ» in its name until the round that writes its page settles the name (entry pending). ‖ AMENDED IN b10 (item N161): the category label of the farm group is «زرعی فارم اور کھجور کے باغات» — the group named by «زرعی فارم»; «باغات» stands there only qualified, «کھجور کے باغات», rendering the source's 'palms' by this ruling's own palm-grove clause; it is not the group's word, which stays refused. The qualified form has been read in place by four b10 blind readers without a remark on «فارم». SETTLED IN b10 (item N154 A): the lime farm keeps «باغ» in its name, «حساوی لیموں کا باغ»; the clause 'until the round that writes its page settles the name' is fulfilled.
calibration_rulings.guard: The header measurement (the label is in the bar): the bar with «زرعی فارم» and «رہائش» needs 1457px against the Urdu block's budget of 1478 (calibrated probe, round 2); the repository's tool was run again on a build of the round-3 text: the Urdu bar stands from 1518px with an overlap of -38px and every cell is sound (b0-ui/measure/repo-tool.verify.on-r3.txt); the probe on the same build gives nav.leisure 155.8px and 1457px for the bar (b0-ui/measure/summary.on-r3.txt).

calibration_rulings.title: Interface nomination: CATEGORY_LABELS.ur.farm ('Farms & palms').
calibration_rulings.binds: src/lib/categories.ts CATEGORY_LABELS.ur.farm (the eyebrow of every /ur/ farm page, the neighbour cards, JSON-LD touristType).
calibration_rulings.ruling: C: CATEGORY_LABELS.ur.farm = «زرعی فارم اور کھجور کے باغات» (written by the coordinator; in the worktree since round 1). SCOPE OF N5, quoted exactly: N5 binds 'nav.leisure; the category label of the farm group …' — THIS label — and refuses «باغات» as the word for the GROUP of farms ('the label's three groups would read as two'). C stays inside N5: the group is still named by its farm word, «زرعی فارم», first in the label; «کھجور کے باغات» renders the source's 'palms' («النخيل») by N5's own clause, 'an orchard or a palm grove is «باغ / باغات»', and by the entry «باغ» ('«کھجور کے باغات» stays the rendering of palm groves'; ur.wikipedia 25 pages, HTTP 200). EVIDENCE: the first reader found «کھجور کے درخت» odd as a category and expected «کھجور کے باغات» (round 1 item 6); the second read C as meant, 'farms and date-palm gardens', and objected only to the zoo and the bird garden being filed under it (round 2 item 12, the source's category). COST: the label shares «باغات» with the parks label «تفریح گاہیں اور باغات» in the index filters, and on sawsan-gardens it stands above a title that also ends «… کے باغات» (proof note 6). The kicker of the three farm pages («مزرعة ونخيل», not rendered) keeps «زرعی فارم اور کھجور کے درخت» — a farm and its palm trees — so one source pair has two renderings, recorded. The «فارم» entry carries the same line (termbase_final); on apply N5 takes it too. ‖ ROUND 3: Unchanged; the third reader read the label as meant and objected only to the zoo and the bird garden under it (items 27, 32: the source's filing). THE QUALIFIED FORM «زرعی فارم» HAS NOW BEEN READ IN PLACE by three b10 readers (on-05 in A, on-r1 and on-r2 in C), none of whom read «فارم» as a form to fill in. LINE DRAFTED FOR N5 (for the coordinator's ap-meta, with this item as its authority): 'AMENDED IN b10 (item N161): the category label of the farm group is «زرعی فارم اور کھجور کے باغات» — the group named by «زرعی فارم»; «باغات» stands there only qualified, «کھجور کے باغات», rendering the source's 'palms' by this ruling's own palm-grove clause; it is not the group's word, which stays refused. The qualified form has been read in place by three blind readers without a remark on «فارم».'
calibration_rulings.guard: For the coordinator: the label written byte for byte. For the proofreader: not a leaf; «باغات» stands in this label only after «کھجور کے», never as the farm group's own word.

calibration_rulings.title: 'Amid the atmosphere of' a place (AR «وسط أجواء»): «فضا» or «ماحول»?
calibration_rulings.binds: sawsan-gardens::summary, body. Every later 'atmosphere' / 'ambience' of a place; not 'open air'.
calibration_rulings.ruling: A: 'the atmosphere of' a place (AR «أجواء») is «… کا ماحول», masculine («نخلستان کے ماحول میں»). Stage 2 replaced «ماحول» by «فضا» on the ground that «ماحول» 'says environment'; rekhta gives both senses for «ماحول» ('atmosphere, environment', Noun, Masculine, HTTP 200), while «فضا» was read by the first reader as the sky. ROUND 2: the second reader found «نخلستان کے ماحول میں» translated and abstract (item 25) — the source's own abstraction; the first reader's misreading of «فضا» was of meaning. Kept. SCOPE: an 'atmosphere' or 'ambience' of a place only; 'open air' (salwa-beach «کھلی فضا میں ورزش کے آلات») is another sense and is untouched. ‖ ROUND 3: Unchanged; the third reader too finds «نخلستان کے ماحول میں» vague (item 28) — the source's own abstraction, two readers on register, none on meaning. ‖ ENTERED ON APPLY (2026-10-14), FROM THE JUDGE'S ADDENDUM TO ROUND 3 (section 4 (e); no string moves): ADDENDUM: the fourth reader too calls «کے ماحول میں» vague and translated: three readers on register, none on meaning. Kept.
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: the 'atmosphere' of a place is «ماحول», not «فضا»; «کھلی فضا» for 'open air' is not touched.
